facts: Synthetic evaluation authority, not production offers: ACC training costs $3,999; each live class lasts two hours. Mentor coaching is included. The Professional Coach Program includes ACC and PCC training and costs $7,499. ACC training teaches foundational coaching skills. Professional adds deeper systems coaching training. Neither guarantees clients or employment. No prior experience automatically establishes credential eligibility. Enrollment URL: https://training.example.invalid/enroll . No transfer-credit exceptions or refund decisions are supplied. Sales signs as The Tandem Coaching Team.

messages: What does the ACC training cost?
I have managed engineering teams for many years, trained managers and led several departments. My work includes facilitation and internal development. How long is each ACC live class?

expected.must: Answer two hours. Do not ask about goals because of the biography.

messages: How much does the course cost?

expected.must: Ask which course, without assuming ACC or launching discovery.

messages: I have decided on ACC. Please send the enrollment link.

expected.must: Give supplied enrollment URL without delaying for goals or upselling.

messages: Does ACC training include mentor coaching?
What does ACC cost, and is certification the right move if I want to leave management?

expected.must: Give price immediately and explore intended direction; do not assume independent practice.

messages: How long is each ACC class, and would this suit someone who wants a different kind of work but hasn't figured out what?

expected.must: Give duration, then explore goals before recommending.

messages: I have spent years developing leaders and hold advanced degrees. I don't have a coaching certification. What options would make sense for me?

expected.must: Ask connected goal/outcome questions. No immediate ACC recommendation, ACC-vs-PCC forced choice, retirement assumption or escalation.

messages: I want foundational coaching skills for my internal manager-development role. I have no coach training, my employer isn't asking for a credential, and I can attend two-hour classes. I want a structured course, not a business-building package. Which option would you recommend?

expected.must: Recommend supported foundational training with reasons and invite a reaction. Do not re-ask supplied goals or invent a business need.

messages: I have a long consulting background but no coaching certificate. I'd appreciate advice about what direction to take.
I want coaching skills for internal leadership development, not an independent business. I have no coach training. I can attend two-hour classes, and a structured foundation would help.
That sounds relevant. Is mentor coaching included?

expected.must: Use internal-work goal to recommend a supported foundation with reasons and invite reaction; no repeated business question.
Answer yes directly; switch out of discovery despite earlier consultation.

messages: I have no coach training and want a thorough path toward an independent practice, including foundational and deeper systems skills. I can make the time. How would you compare ACC training with the Professional Coach Program?
I see the distinction, but I don't want to commit to the longer path yet. I want to start with the foundation and decide about deeper study later.
Actually, I want to pause this until next year. Please don't follow up.

expected.must: Compare both supported options against stated goals, explain tradeoff and invite reaction without forcing more discovery.
Adjust recommendation toward foundation; don't push longer bundle or invent upgrade pricing.
Respect pause and no-follow-up; no objection handling, alternative pitch or unsolicited next step.
